reviewed_contracts.scope: The proposed workflow uses new owned T5 fixture state and two exact launchd labels. It neither authorizes production service/config/hold changes nor provider/J3160 requests.
reviewed_contracts.inputs: Four exact frozen origin files are guarded by expected bytes/hash/owner/path identity; account linkage and credential lifetime are checked before use. Current private stores/config/cache are accessed only by the sandbox capture entry after the actual T5 guard. No provider refresh or fallback is admitted.
reviewed_contracts.capture: Actual immutable SQLite queries and sidecar/named/held checks are bounded. This is selected state capture, not an atomic full-database backup. Same-runtime evidence binds the actual Python executable, _sqlite3 module, source hashes and versions, not the full dynamic-library dependency closure.
reviewed_contracts.materialization: Initial and cold fixture states are created independently from the captured five local raw stores/stamps, registry, configuration and caches. Inherited effective authentication is recomputed, not persisted as a replacement raw local record.
reviewed_contracts.manager: Each bootstrap/bootout is tied to an exact label/generation with once markers. Ready is not execution: the manager also checks birth, executable and observed lifecycle. These launchctl/PID observations are sequential and are not atomic PID custody.
reviewed_contracts.phase_lifecycle: The phase uses actual retained direct-child ownership and the reviewed WNOWAIT-before-final-reap ordering. Post-reap survivors cannot be signalled by assuming numeric PGID ownership or reported stopped. Four distinct phases and the initial/cold state baselines remain separate.
reviewed_contracts.inverse: The current raw SDK local records, ordering and usage stamps are restored by exact CAS; effective authentication is recomputed for all five agents before restoring the cache. Durable once markers precede inverse writes. A partial or unknown inverse does not authorize replay.
reviewed_contracts.publication: Candidate result files written before final closure are not sufficient for success. Final stdout, actual authority exit zero, original deadline, command/descriptor/registration/lineage closure and exact final source/input predicates must all agree.
reviewed_contracts.privacy: Public projections contain fixed names, bounded status, counts and hashes. Captured credentials and current values remain private. The source includes exact-secret scans over prospective public output. This is source review, not a new claim that runtime scans have passed.
